component.name: SuperAwesomeMagical Browser
component.summary: Ladybird with your tabs down the side, in the SuperAwesomeMagical look

description.p: Ladybird, the independent browser, set up the SuperAwesomeMagical way: tabs down the left side, Lexend for the interface and for pages, the Lavender colour, Ecosia for searches, ads and trackers blocked, and a start page with a big clock over the northern lights.
Ladybird itself comes from Ladybird's own package, which keeps it up to date. Ladybird is in alpha: some sites won't work yet.
